approvalBasis: The independent NewsStand review dated 2026-07-25 found the material claims entailed by the three cited sources. This record does not approve deployment.

claims.claim: Google said it signed the EU AI Act Code of Practice on Transparency of AI-Generated Content and connected that commitment to C2PA and SynthID.
claims.assessment: Entailed vendor announcement, labelled in the reader.

claims.claim: The European Commission describes the code as voluntary and says adherence is not conclusive evidence of compliance.
Provenance can support origin/edit-history checks but does not itself establish whether a claim is true.
claims.assessment: Clearly presented as LAiDIES analysis rather than a regulator quote.
